seo_title: NCLAT Delhi: Appeal Non-Est Without Certified Copy
title: NCLAT Delhi Holds IBC Appeal Non-Est Where Certified Copy Was Sought Only on the 66th Day
case_name: Anil Khandelwal and NOIDA Holdings Pvt. Ltd. v. Committee of Creditors of Technofab Engineering Ltd. and Anr.
citation: Company Appeal (AT) (Insolvency) No. 1720 of 2026, NCLAT New Delhi, order dated 4 November 2026
card_summary: The NCLAT's New Delhi bench dismissed an appeal against rejection of Technofab Engineering Ltd.'s resolution plan, filed by a former director with NOIDA Holdings Pvt. Ltd. The appellants sought a certified copy of the NCLT order only on the 66th day, after limitation had run, making the appeal non-est in law. The bench refused condonation of delay and exemption from filing the certified copy, and closed the matter.
card_tip: Apply for the certified copy of an NCLT order within the limitation period before filing an NCLAT appeal; filing the appeal alone does not cure a late application, and it can be treated as never having been filed.
